purpose: Prevent unreviewed growth of central modules while separating runtime dependency coupling from compile-time type coupling.

baseline.note: Current-source baseline for the module boundary contract. Only module paths present in the canonical source tree are budgeted. Persistence state-default submodules from historical PR #109 are intentionally excluded because they are not in this source tree; they remain a separate migration aspect.

modules.reason: Largest canonical runtime dependency hub (417 total / 379 runtime outgoing edges in schema-v3 graph). Keep a small, explicit budget while future extraction reduces this composition root; do not add production inbound owners.

Compatibility facade owns the public field surface; constructor objects are created in four bounded instance groups. Keep the facade at 21 total edges (4 runtime factory edges plus 17 type-only contracts).
